name: Barking and Dagenham
affordable_target_note: SP3: 50% strategic target on all housing schemes (London Plan H4). DMH1: schemes of 10+ units or >1,000 sqm GIA must provide affordable housing measured in habitable rooms, via the London Plan H5 threshold approach with early/late review for Viability Tested Route. Tenure per Figure 13 (split not extracted). Adopted September 2024.
borough_cil_note: Zoned, 2015 base rates: Zone 1 Barking Town Centre/Leftley £70, Zone 2 Barking Riverside £25, Zone 3 rest of borough (most of borough) £10. Indexed 2024 rates £104.59 / £37.35 / £14.94.
tall_building_definition: DMD2: taller than six storeys or 18m (ground to uppermost floor level), as London Plan D9. Tall Building Locations in SPP1-SPP6 on Policies Map; up to 95m in Barking TC zone, up to 50m elsewhere.
priorities: Family homes first, 50% affordable, regeneration-led growth, tenure-blind design

name: Barnet
affordable_target_note: Strategic target that 50% of new homes are genuinely affordable (para 4.4.5); Policy HOU01 seeks a minimum 35% affordable on all developments of 10+ dwellings. Tenure split not confirmed from primary source. Plan incorporates Inspectors' Main Modifications; adoption report Jan/Feb 2025.
borough_cil_note: Single borough-wide rate. Revised Charging Schedule applies from 1 April 2022 (replacing 2013 £135); £300 residential (C2, C3, C4) per submitted schedule. Indexed annually (Reg 40). barnet.gov.uk blocked direct fetch of adopted schedule.
tall_building_definition: CDH04: tall = 8+ storeys (26m+ above ground); very tall = 15+ storeys (45m+), not permitted unless exceptional. Tall (8-14 storeys) may suit named strategic locations: Brent Cross, Brent Cross West, Colindale, Cricklewood, Edgware, West Hendon.
priorities: Growth areas, genuinely affordable homes, heights limited to strategic locations

name: Bexley
affordable_target_note: SP2: aspiration for 50% strategic target across qualifying provision over plan period via the DP1 threshold approach (35%, or 50% in some circumstances, fast-track). Tenure 70% low cost rent / 30% intermediate. Adopted 26 April 2023.
borough_cil_note: Zoned: Zone 1 (north of railway line) £40, Zone 2 (south) £60; also hotel and student housing. Charging schedule 2015; rates indexed.
tall_building_definition: DP12: more than 25m (about 8 storeys). Suitable Locations for Tall Buildings near Abbey Wood and Belvedere stations, up to 45m max, on Policies Map; exception not rule.
priorities: Suburban character, human-scaled typologies, 50% affordable aspiration, low-cost rent

name: Brent
affordable_target_note: BH5: strategic target 50% of new homes to 2041; London Plan H5 threshold approach applies. Non-Build-to-Rent schemes of 10+ dwellings: 70% Social Rent/London Affordable Rent, 30% intermediate. Council prioritises social/LAR over a higher headline %. Adopted February 2022.
borough_cil_note: Single borough-wide rate for residential (C3, C4, C2 except hospitals, student, HMO). 2013 schedule; indexed 2025 rate £349.11.
tall_building_definition: BD2: more than 30m above ground (about 10 storeys). Directed to Tall Building Zones on policies map (e.g. Wembley, Alperton, South Kilburn) with general heights, stepping down to zone edges.
priorities: Social rent priority, 50% affordable, growth areas, Tall Building Zones

name: Bromley
affordable_target_note: Policy 2: seek 35% (habitable rooms) on sites of 11+ units or >1,000 sqm; 60% social/affordable rented, 40% intermediate; below 35% needs independently assessed viability appraisal. Adopted 16 January 2019; plan under review.
borough_cil_note: Single borough-wide residential rate; effective 15 June 2021; indexed (RICS CIL index).
tall_building_definition: Policy 47: no numeric threshold; tall buildings exceed general height of surroundings and significantly change skyline. Most of borough unsuitable (suburban); Bromley Town Centre AAP identifies potential sites.
priorities: Suburban character protection, 35% affordable, town-centre-only tall buildings

name: Camden
affordable_target_note: H4: 50% for schemes with capacity for 25+ homes; sliding scale from 2% (1 home) rising 2% per home below 25; borough target 5,300 affordable homes 2016/17-2030/31. Guideline 60% social-affordable rent, 40% intermediate. Adopted July 2017; new Local Plan submitted Oct 2025, adoption not confirmed.
borough_cil_note: 2020 charging schedule. Residential 10+ units: Zone A (central) £150, Zone B (rest of Camden) £250, Zone C (Hampstead/Highgate) £500; under 10 units £500 all zones. Indexed. Rates from council PDF via search extract (direct fetch blocked).
tall_building_definition: D1 (para 7.35): no numeric threshold; buildings substantially taller than neighbours or significantly changing the skyline. All of Camden treated as sensitive; case-by-case design tests.
priorities: Maximise affordable homes, small-scheme contributions, heritage-sensitive design

name: City of London
affordable_target_note: CS21: 10+ unit schemes provide 30% affordable on-site; exceptionally 60% off-site or cash-in-lieu if on-site unviable; 60% social/affordable rent, 40% intermediate. City Plan 2040 not yet adopted (inspectors backed it Sept 2026; adoption expected by end of 2026).
borough_cil_note: Zoned: Residential Riverside £150, Rest of City £95 (most of the City). Approved 1 May 2014, effective 1 July 2014; indexed annually.
tall_building_definition: Local Plan 2015 CS14: no numeric threshold; tall buildings in Eastern Cluster; refused in conservation areas, St Paul's Heights, protected vistas, Monument views (Policies Map). Emerging City Plan 2040 S12: over 75m AOD.
priorities: Office-led growth, limited housing, off-site affordable, Eastern Cluster towers

name: Croydon
affordable_target_note: SP2.4: negotiate up to 50% on sites of 10+ dwellings, subject to viability; 60:40 affordable rent:intermediate; SP2.5 minimum 30% on-site (with Opportunity Area alternatives). Supporting text sets a 40% strategic target of overall supply.
borough_cil_note: 2013 schedule (effective 1 April 2013): Croydon Metropolitan Centre £0 residential, rest of borough £120 (most of borough); indexed. Revised schedule examined 26 Feb 2026, examiner report April 2026; adoption not confirmed.
tall_building_definition: Para 6.9: significantly taller than most surrounding buildings, or over six storeys or 25m. SP4.5: encouraged only in Croydon Opportunity Area, District Centres and well-connected transport interchanges.
priorities: Family homes (30% 3-bed), up to 50% affordable, Opportunity Area density

name: Ealing
affordable_target_note: Policy 1.2(a): at least 50% of housing to 2026 affordable; 50% on-site starting point for 10+ units; 60% social/affordable rent, 40% intermediate. Adopted 3 April 2012; new Local Plan at examination (Reg 22), not adopted.
borough_cil_note: First borough CIL: Central Ealing £300, rest of borough £150 (most of borough). Approved by Full Council 16 Dec 2025, charged from 1 March 2026.
tall_building_definition: Core Strategy: no numeric threshold; tall buildings only on specified sites in Acton, Ealing and Southall town centres, Park Royal gateways and identified development sites (via Development Sites DPD/SPDs).
priorities: 50% affordable, family homes, tall buildings only in town centres

name: Enfield
affordable_target_note: Core Policy 3: borough-wide 40% target on sites of 10+ dwellings; smaller sites pay off-site contributions against a 20% target. Tenure split not confirmed. enfield.gov.uk blocked direct fetch; values from search-index extracts of council PDFs. New Local Plan 2019-2041 still under examination.
borough_cil_note: Zoned: RR1 Meridian Water £0, RR2 eastern corridor £40, RR3 intermediate £60, RR4 remainder of borough £120; indexed. Adoption year not confirmed; from search extract of council charging schedule.
priorities: 40% affordable, small-site contributions, Meridian Water regeneration

name: Greenwich

local_plan.name: Royal Greenwich Local Plan: Core Strategy with Detailed Policies

affordable_target_note: Policy H3: minimum 35% affordable on 10+ homes or sites of 0.5ha+ (AMR 2024-25). Tenure split not confirmed. Adopted 30 July 2014; new Local Plan Reg 19 closed 6 Sept 2026, submission expected end 2026.
borough_cil_note: BCIL2 adopted 24 July 2024 (in force 26 July 2024): 10+ units Zone 1 £150, Zone 2 £96; under 10 units £150. Replaces 2015 schedule (£40/£70). Indexed.
priorities: 35% affordable minimum, family-sized homes, identified tall building locations
